name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceDuplicatesExcludeQuestionLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when duplicate-ad protection routes an advertised app task to the tryout page. It offers the app's download or launch experience and tracks the user's choice.
disableEffect: This duplicate-aware advertised-app tryout and download route will no longer open.
